description: Run when asked what a wallet holds or is worth. One call instead of balance + tokens + history, and spam is kept out of the total. SOL balance, top tokens with USD values, estimated total worth, and recent activity, in one answer. Inputs: wallet: The wallet address to sum up. network (optional): Which Solana network to read. Default "mainnet-beta" (real money). Cost: 25 free calls a day, then $0.01 USDC per call (x402). Full field-by-field docs: GET /api/tools/wallet.
name: wallet
